senses.gloss:
उलिन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a country.
 E. उल् to burn, किन्दच् aff.

उल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्)
 1. Painting, writing.
 2. Making lines or
streaks, above or on high.
 3. Scratching, scraping.
 4. Bearing,
raising.
 E. उद् before लिख् to write, शतृ aff.

उल्लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Thrown up, tossed.
 2. Pared, made thin.
3. Scraped, scratched.
 4. Painted, delineated.
 5. Written over or
above.
 E. उद् and लिखित written.

उल्लिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discriminated, distinguished, known.
 E. उद्
before लिगि to mark, and क्त aff.
